set.approach: Start at the Mirror Lake trailhead at the end of Forest Road 5480, a short drive from I-90 exit 62, at about 3,600 ft. Hike the Mirror Lake trail about 1 mile to the Cottonwood Lake spur, then roughly 0.6 mile more to the Pacific Crest Trail. Turn north on the PCT for about 0.6 mile to the point where a boot path leaves the trail on the left and climbs toward the peak's northwest ridge.
set.descent_text: Reverse the ridge on the boot path, taking care with the loose rock on the final scramble and the one short Class 3 gully crossing near the top. Back on the PCT, turn south and drop down the Mirror Lake trail past Cottonwood Lake to the trailhead, about 6 miles round trip for the day.

review.notes: Trailhead, mileages and the PCT/boot-path junction from the Mountaineers listing and WTA (Mountaineers page was blocked to fetch; read via search summaries). Class 3 gully and loose final scramble from the SummitPost NW route summary; Windy Pass option from the Silver/Tinkham listing. Exact start of the NW ridge off the boot path is inferred.

set.descent_text: Reverse the Class 3-4 scramble from the summit blocks down the ridge and slopes to Glacier Basin, watching for loose rock. From the basin, follow Glacier Basin Trail #719 down to the South Fork Sauk River crossing, then the gated Monte Cristo road about 4 miles back to Barlow Pass. A bicycle left at the gate saves time on the road.

review.notes: Class 3/4 rating and the crevassed glacier east of the Wilmans peaks from the Weld trip report; Glacier Basin return to Monte Cristo from the Wilmans Spire account; trail #719 and the 4-mile road from the row's existing approach text.
